pages.title: File:Moshe Haim Luzzato's Torah Book Ramhal.JPG

ObjectName.value: Moshe Haim Luzzato's Torah Book Ramhal

Categories.value: GFDL|Taken with Canon PowerShot S3 IS|Ramhal Synagogue|License migration redundant|Self-published work|1740s texts|Torah scrolls (open)|Torah scrolls (Sefardi style)|Elef Milim - Acco

ImageDescription.value:
The Torah book written by Rabbi Moshe Haim Luzzato (RAMHAL, רמח"ל) in the 1740s in Acre. The scroll is made of deer skin, and the ink was concocted by boiling pomegranate peel. The book is in Luzzato's synagogue, in the Old City of Acre, Israel.
This image was taken as part of the Elef Millim project trip to the Old City of Acco, which was held on Friday, 5th March 2010.
